title: NASA: warming is unequivocal and human activity is the principal cause
summary: NASA's evidence page states both the warming and the attribution, and points to the IPCC.
body: NASA's climate evidence page says there is unequivocal evidence that Earth is warming at an unprecedented rate and that human activity is the principal cause. It says the current warming is happening at a rate not seen in the past 10,000 years, and it points readers to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change. This is NASA's summary of the assessment, fetched 18 November 2026. It is an attribution statement, stronger than "temperatures have varied before," and it is not itself a policy recommendation. Mitigation choices are a separate kind of claim.
